title: codonoboea kelantanensis
intro: Codonoboea kelantanensis, commonly known as the Kelantan Codonoboea or Kelantan Soursop, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Malaysian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimalarial properties. The therapeutic actions of Codonoboea kelantanensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and possess analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
